description: This Java class serializes HttpRequest objects into curl command strings, including headers, cookies, and request details.

classes.name: HttpRequestToCurlSerializer
classes.description: A class that converts HttpRequest objects into curl command strings, including headers, cookies, and request details.

methods.name: HttpRequestToCurlSerializer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the serializer with a logger.

methods.description: Generates a curl command string from an HttpRequest, optionally including remote address.
